Chapter 6488: Senior Xian Chengtian

Chapter 6488: Senior Xian Chengtian

North Kun God might just be the strongest primal ancestor in Old World, causing the others to feel inferior.

He was only one step away from finishing the return path, shouldering the ambition of Everlasting Jiang and Fardao.

“Long time no see, Fellow Daoist.” The woman didn’t fear him, seemingly one with the night without falling to the darkness. This was her most powerful state, exuding a hint of immortal light capable of heralding a new world.

“Long time no see, Fairy. Is Senior Xian Chengtian doing well?” North Kun God had a serious expression.

Ocean-gaze and Whale Ancestor didn’t recognize her but the courteous response shocked them.

Xian Chengtian was known and feared throughout Three Immortals since he was a supreme overlord - a disciple taught by three ancient immortals. Some believed he was the strongest beneath the immortal realm, only rivaled by the Lord of Life and Death.

However, the lord was mysterious and no one saw her in action. Thus, they lacked an accurate assessment of her battle potential. Some still believed she was the strongest when not counting immortals but this might be slightly unreasonable.

Xian Chengtian, on the other hand, had fought all over the world. He survived the wrath of immortals and earned his prestige.

“His disciple from Heaven World?” Everyone shuddered.

Eight-armed Immortal Child was impressive but couldn’t compare to this woman. Only North Kun God was qualified to fight her.

“Very well.” The woman nodded in response: “Please return, Fellow Daoist. It is over.”

“I’m afraid it is not up to you.” North Kun God said.

“Do you wish to fight us?” She asked.

“It wouldn’t be a fair fight.” North Kun God said dominantly, never besmirching his master’s reputation.

“Rather confident.” She said.

“Yes.” North Kun God gazed at his opponent. Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, Trinity, and even the woman didn’t have the same aura of domination.

“Your vitality ran out and would only recover to sixty or seventy percent. However, what do you think is your probability of winning even at your prime?” He asked.

Her expression changed. Although victory was in her grasp, his aura and momentum still overwhelmed her.

“Desolate Ancestor’s legacy remains unshaken, I have nothing but admiration.” She said.

“I have only learned the bare surface of my master’s teachings, I don’t dare to bring up our connection lest it brings shame for I am an unworthy disciple.” North Kun God said.

“The bare surface is more than we can handle.” She admitted. This didn’t tarnish her master’s reputation either.

North Kun God was a direct disciple of an immortal. This status trumped all else in Three Immortals except Weizhen from Supreme Heaven.

However, he didn’t take pride in this since he believed his cultivation was inadequate. His path was tougher and innately inferior to the imperial path. Not even Fardao and Everlasting Jiang took it to the next step.

“I’m afraid you can’t turn the tides today, Fellow Daoist, regardless of how powerful you may be.” She said: “But if you insist, we will entertain you.”

She held the flute horizontally in front of her chest. It radiated an overwhelming immortal aura, suffocating all who lay eyes on it.

“You came prepared indeed.” North Kun said, aware of the immortal artifact’s true potential.
